digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler / outbound mutation / text field sanitization
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions that Cloud has, creating risk of silent re-emission on truncation mismatch
the DC comment truncation path binds both comment and description to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT with unclear provenance, whereas Cloud uses a separate comment_limits module
DC's _diff_comments can fall back to Cloud's sanitizer via config when no explicit sanitizer is injected, causing DC convergence tests to inadvertently validate Cloud behavior
the correct DC comment ceiling is 32767 chars per jira.text.field.character.limit default and JRASERVER-28519, not an unverified assumption

DC convergence tests must use value-based discriminators for descriptions (plain 32767 vs Cloud's ADF 32000) and identity/recording checks for comments (to avoid vacuous-green tests that pass under both sanitizers)
